name: A2A adenosine receptor upregulation
driver: unresolved (B and dB/dt collinear; dose behaves as amplitude x time)
driver_note: Every Ferrara/IGEA dataset used one fixed pulse shape (1.3 ms, 75 Hz), so B and dB/dt scale together. In rat cortex 3 mT x 2 h gave the same fold change as 1.5 mT x 4 h. Frequency was never varied.

dBdt_Ts.basis: computed from recalled probe inputs (50 turns, 0.5 cm ID, 2 mV); inputs are UNVERIFIED, treat as order of magnitude

E_Vm.basis: computed, uniform B circular path; well geometry not reported

windows.time_course: neutrophils ~1 h; rat cortex peak 4 h at 1.5 mT, 2 h at 3 mT, transient (1.4-fold at 6 h)

evidence: in vitro / ex vivo radioligand binding, one lab network
confidence: moderate for effect at 1.5 mT with this pulse; low for any sub-1 mT threshold; speculative for B vs dB/dt
caveat: Varani 2002 low-dose threshold (0.5-1 mT) and plateau (1.5-3.5 mT) came from a full-text page and are NOT verified against the table. mRNA unchanged, so not simple transcriptional upregulation. 32998161 (Colombini/Vinhas group, tendon cells) shows only part of the binding comparison significant. No independent replication.

name: A3 adenosine receptor upregulation
driver_note: Co-reported with A2A in synoviocytes, chondrocytes, osteoblasts, tumour lines and neurons at the same 75 Hz / 1.3 ms signal. No A3-specific amplitude series.

windows.basis: group standard, not stated in every abstract

evidence: in vitro, one lab network; no nulls found (lab concentration, not robustness)

name: NF-kB and cytokine suppression (IL-1b, TNF-a, IL-6, IL-8, PGE2)
driver: pulse pattern / frequency; amplitude evidence thin
driver_note: Chen 2021: two fields with fundamentals 51.8 and 52.3 Hz differing only in send-pause grouping polarised macrophages in opposite directions (blinded screen of 22 fields). Xu 2022: at fixed 1 mT the 75 Hz condition was best (full ordering of 15/45/75 Hz is not supported by the abstract). Taylor 2014: same device, different duty schedule, works versus fails.

dBdt_Ts.basis: computed; sinusoid assumed where waveform not stated

schedule.taylor: 20 min per 4 h or 15 min per 2 h works; 5 min per 20 min fails
schedule.parate: single 10 min dose beat repeats (MSC chondrogenesis, 2 mT, 15 Hz, 6 ms bursts)

evidence: in vitro in primed cells; rat/mouse OA models; human trials mixed
confidence: moderate that 1-4 mT pulses can lower IL-1b/IL-6/PGE2 in primed cells; low for numbers
caveat: Context dependent: naive RAW264.7 at 0.8 mT/60 Hz sine showed PRO-inflammatory output (Kim 2017) and Lin 2011 (not Ferrara-group) found raised NO in LPS macrophages at 1.5 mT/75 Hz. 36377077 (Xu, AMSC exosomes, Cartilage) and 36854553 are separate papers. Zou 2017 intensity given in A/m, not convertible to B.

name: Macrophage / microglia polarisation
driver: pulse grouping / timing (Chen 2021); B and dB/dt not decomposed
driver_note: Identical fundamental, different send-pause: opposite polarisation. Strongest discriminator for pattern over amplitude in this dataset.
evidence: in vitro blinded screen plus Ferrara-network microglia work
caveat: Direction on microglial phagocytosis differs by context (down with LPS in Merighi 2019, up after ICH in Yang 2022).

name: PEMF analgesia (NO pathway, post-op pain, OA pain)
driver: unresolved; time-varying properties implicated (schedule, pulse width, frequency), no controlled dB/dt test
driver_note: Rat 5 mT / 50 Hz analgesia peaks day 7 and is NO-pathway dependent (sine dB/dt 1.57 T/s computed). Prato 2011 shielded-mouse effect scales with B x f, threshold at or below ~1000 nT x Hz (dB/dt 6.3 uT/s computed, E ~3e-8 V/m), a microtesla regime unrelated to OA doses. Post-operative RF-pulsed regimens give the best sham-controlled signal. Sorrell: 42 us vs 38 us pulse width trends only.

dBdt_Ts.basis: computed for sine; authors class thresholds are narrative

windows.schedule: rat: 4 x 30 min/day, 15 days; wuschech: 2 x 5 min/day, 18 days; Bagnato 12 h/day 1 month

evidence: rat studies; RCTs split (Thamsborg, Ozguclu, Pipitone null; Wuschech, Bagnato positive; Cochrane pain MD 15.1/100 with reporting-bias concerns, function and QoL n.s.)
confidence: low overall; moderate that some post-op pulsed-RF regimens reduce early pain
caveat: No ELF B or dB/dt analgesic threshold can be set from this evidence. Xiang 2022 is a protocol only. Leyva 2026 dichotomy is a narrative synthesis the authors call exploratory. Wuschech was partly randomised.
